question: Baji Raut, a young boy from Odisha, became a martyr when he was shot by British police for refusing to ferry them across a river to reach freedom fighters. How old was he?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12 years old**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 

__ 
 
• **Baji Raut** was a **12-year-old boy** from Odisha who became a martyr in India’s freedom struggle. 
 
• He was shot dead by the **British police** for refusing to ferry them across the Brahmani River to pursue freedom fighters. 
 
• Baji Raut was a member of the **Banara Satyagraha**, which was a movement opposing British colonial rule in Odisha. 
 
• Despite his young age, Baji Raut displayed **immense courage** and refused to assist the British police, knowing the consequences. 
 
• His sacrifice is remembered as an act of **bravery and patriotism**, symbolizing the resistance of ordinary Indians, including children, against colonial oppression. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 

__ 
 
• **Baji Raut’s Background:** 
 
 
• He was born into a poor family in the village of **Nilakanthapur** in Odisha. 
 
• His father was a boatman, and Baji followed in his footsteps, working as a ferryman on the **Brahmani River**. 
 
 
 
• **Incident Details:** 
 
 
• In 1938, during the **Prajamandal Movement**, the British police were chasing freedom fighters who had taken refuge across the Brahmani River. 
 
• Baji Raut, upon realizing the police intentions, **refused to ferry them** across the river, despite threats. 
 
• He was shot dead along with other volunteers, making him one of the **youngest martyrs** in India’s freedom struggle. 
 
 
 
• **Legacy:** 
 
 
• Baji Raut’s heroism is celebrated in Odisha and across India as an example of **selfless sacrifice** for the nation. 
 
• Several monuments and schools in Odisha have been named after him to honor his contribution. 
 
 
 
• **Prajamandal Movement:** 
 
 
• This movement was a significant part of India’s freedom struggle, focused on opposing the **British rule in princely states**. 
 
• It aimed to organize protests against the oppressive policies of feudal rulers and the British administration. 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 

 
 
• **Youngest Martyrs:** 
 
 
• Baji Raut is regarded as one of the **youngest martyrs** in India’s history, symbolizing the involvement of people from all walks of life and age groups in the freedom struggle. 
 
• Other young martyrs include **Khudiram Bose**, who was executed at the age of 18 for his role in revolutionary activities. 
 
 
 
• **Role of Odisha in Freedom Struggle:** 
 
 
• Odisha played a significant role in India’s independence movement, with movements like the **Quit India Movement** and the **Prajamandal Movement**. 
 
• Leaders such as **Gopabandhu Das** and **Harekrushna Mahatab** contributed immensely to the struggle against colonial rule.
